title: A and an
intro: Use a or an before one thing that is not specific. Choose by the first SOUND of the next word, not the letter.
introTr: Belirli olmayan tek bir şeyden önce a/an kullanılır. Seçim harfe değil, sonraki kelimenin İLK SESİNE göre yapılır. Türkçede tanımlık yok; bu yüzden "I have car" gibi a'yı unutmak en sık hatadır.

points.tr: Ünsüz sesle başlayan kelimeden önce a
Ünlü sesle başlayan kelimeden önce an

points.en: Not with plural or uncountable nouns

quiz.q: He studies at ___ university in Ankara.

title: The
intro: Use the when the listener knows which one you mean: it was mentioned before, there is only one, or the context makes it clear.
introTr: Dinleyen hangisini kastettiğini biliyorsa the kullanılır: daha önce söz edildiyse, tek bir tane varsa ya da bağlamdan belliyse. Türkçede bunu çoğu zaman belirtme hâli (-ı/-i) karşılar: "Kitabı okudum" = I read the book.

examples: I bought a shirt. The shirt is blue.
the sun, the moon, the internet

quiz.q: This is ___ best pizza in town.
I saw a dog and a cat. ___ dog was black.

title: No article
intro: Many common phrases have no article. Talking about things in general also uses no article.
introTr: Birçok kalıpta tanımlık yoktur. Genel olarak bir şeyden söz ederken de tanımlık kullanılmaz. Türkçe konuşanlar bazen fazladan the ekler: "The life is hard" yanlış, "Life is hard" doğru.

points.en: General statements with plural or uncountable nouns
Fixed phrases: go to school, go to bed, at home, at work, by bus
points.tr: Kalıplar: okula gitmek, yatmak, evde, işte, otobüsle
examples: I go to work by bus.

points.tr: Çoğu ülke, şehir ve sokak adı

quiz.q: I usually go to ___ bed at eleven.

title: In, on, at: place
intro: Turkish uses one ending (-de/-da) where English uses three prepositions. Think of in = inside, on = touching a surface, at = a point.
introTr: Türkçede tek bir ek (-de/-da) var, İngilizcede üç edat. in = içinde, on = bir yüzeye değerek, at = bir nokta/konum.

points.en: in: inside a space, a city or a country
points.tr: in: bir alanın içinde, şehir, ülke

points.en: on: on a surface, a floor, a street (US), transport you stand in
points.tr: on: yüzey, kat, (ABD) cadde, ayakta binilen taşıt

points.en: at: a point or a place for an activity
points.tr: at: bir nokta ya da faaliyet yeri

points.en: Addresses: at + number, on + street, in + city
points.tr: Adres: at + numara, on + cadde, in + şehir

quiz.q: We were ___ the bus when it started to rain.

title: In, on, at: time
intro: From big to small: in for long periods, on for days and dates, at for exact times.
introTr: Büyükten küçüğe: in uzun dönemler, on günler ve tarihler, at kesin saatler için.

points.en: in: months, years, seasons, parts of the day
points.tr: in: ay, yıl, mevsim, günün bölümleri

points.en: at: clock times and fixed phrases
No preposition with this, next, last, every
points.tr: this, next, last, every ile edat kullanılmaz

title: To and for
intro: To shows direction or a goal; for shows a purpose, a benefit or a period of time.
introTr: to yön ya da hedef bildirir; for amaç, yarar ya da süre bildirir. "I came here for learn" yanlış; fiille amaç bildirirken to kullanılır: "I came here to learn".

points.tr: for + isim = amaç ya da yarar

examples: I lived there for three years.

quiz.q: I went to the shop ___ buy some milk.

title: Of, from, by, with
intro: Four very frequent prepositions with clear core meanings.
introTr: Çok sık kullanılan dört edat ve temel anlamları.

points.en: by: who does it; how you travel; a deadline

quiz.q: This song is ___ my favorite band.
I usually go to work ___ car.
She's going to the cinema ___ her friends.

title: Will and going to
intro: Both talk about the future. Use going to for plans you have already made; use will for decisions you make now, promises and predictions.
introTr: İkisi de geleceği anlatır. Önceden yapılmış planlar için going to, konuşurken verilen kararlar, sözler ve tahminler için will kullanılır.

examples: I'm going to visit my aunt on Sunday.
The phone's ringing. I'll answer it.

points.en: Contractions: I'll, you'll, won't (= will not)
points.tr: Kısaltmalar: I'll, you'll, won't (= will not)

quiz.q: Look at those clouds! It's ___ rain.
We've booked the tickets. We ___ fly to Rome in May.

title: Would
intro: Would makes requests and offers polite, and talks about imagined situations.
introTr: would rica ve teklifleri kibarlaştırır ve hayalî durumları anlatır. Türkçedeki "-r mıydı / -erdi" yapısına benzer.

examples: Would you open the door, please?
If I had more time, I would travel.
Daha çok zamanım olsa seyahat ederdim.

quiz.q: ___ you like to come with us?
If I won the lottery, I ___ buy a house.
I'd ___ a table for two, please.
I'd ___ walk than take the bus.

title: Can, could, may, might
intro: These modal verbs talk about ability, permission and possibility. They never take -s and are followed by the base verb.
introTr: Bu yardımcı fiiller yetenek, izin ve olasılık bildirir. -s almazlar ve arkalarından yalın fiil gelir: "She can swims" yanlış, "She can swim" doğru.

quiz.q: ___ you pass me the salt, please?
Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.
When I was young, I ___ run very fast.

title: Must, have to, should
intro: Must and have to show obligation; should gives advice. Careful: don't have to means it isn't necessary, mustn't means it is not allowed.
introTr: must ve have to zorunluluk, should tavsiye bildirir. Dikkat: don't have to = gerekmiyor, mustn't = yasak. Bu ikisi Türkçe konuşanların sık karıştırdığı bir çifttir.

points.en: must: strong obligation (often from the speaker)

examples: I have to wear a uniform.

points.tr: mustn't (yasak) ve don't have to (gerek yok)

quiz.q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
In Turkey, children ___ go to school.

title: Some, any, much, many
intro: Some in positive sentences and offers, any in questions and negatives. Many with countable nouns, much with uncountable nouns.
introTr: some olumlu cümlede ve tekliflerde, any soru ve olumsuzda. many sayılabilen, much sayılamayan isimlerle. Günlük konuşmada olumlu cümlede much yerine a lot of daha doğaldır.

points.en: a lot of works with both
points.tr: a lot of ikisiyle de kullanılır
examples: a lot of books / a lot of time

quiz.q: Is there ___ milk in the fridge?

title: This, that, these, those
intro: This/these for things near you, that/those for things farther away. These and those are plural.
introTr: this/these yakındaki, that/those uzaktaki şeyler için. these ve those çoğuldur. Telaffuz: this /ðɪs/ kısa, these /ðiːz/ uzun.

points.en: On the phone: This is Ali.

title: Do, does, did
intro: In the present and past simple, questions and negatives need do, does or did. The main verb goes back to its base form.
introTr: Geniş zaman ve geçmiş zamanda soru ve olumsuz için do/does/did gerekir; ana fiil yalın hâline döner: "Did you went?" yanlış, "Did you go?" doğru.

points.en: Questions: Do you…? Does she…? Did they…?
points.tr: Soru: Do you…? Does she…? Did they…?

points.en: Negatives: don't, doesn't, didn't + base verb
points.tr: Olumsuz: don't, doesn't, didn't + yalın fiil

title: Be and there is
intro: Turkish often needs no verb ("Ben öğretmenim"), but English always needs be: I am a teacher. Use there is/are to say something exists (var).
introTr: Türkçede çoğu zaman fiil gerekmez ("Ben öğretmenim"), İngilizcede be şarttır: I am a teacher. Bir şeyin var olduğunu söylemek için there is/are kullanılır (= var).

points.en: there is + singular / there are + plural
points.tr: there is + tekil / there are + çoğul
examples: There is a park near here.
Is there a bank near here?

title: I, me, my, mine, myself
intro: English pronouns change form depending on their job in the sentence. Turkish has no he/she difference, so English learners often mix them up.
introTr: İngilizce zamirler cümledeki görevine göre biçim değiştirir. Türkçede "o" hem kadın hem erkek için kullanıldığından he/she karışıklığı çok yaygındır.

points.en: Subject: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
points.tr: Özne: ben, sen, o (erkek), o (kadın), o (şey), biz, onlar

points.en: Object: me, you, him, her, it, us, them
Possessive: my, your, his, her, its, our, their
Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs / myself, yourself…

quiz.q: My mother is a nurse. ___ works at night.

title: And, but, or, so, because
intro: These five words join ideas. So introduces a result; because introduces a reason.
introTr: Bu beş kelime fikirleri bağlar. so sonuç, because sebep bildirir: "It was raining, so we stayed home" / "We stayed home because it was raining."

examples: I was hungry, so I ate.
I ate because I was hungry.

quiz.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
She stayed home ___ she was ill.
The hotel was old ___ very clean.

title: Who, which, that
intro: Use these words to add information about a noun. Turkish puts this information before the noun ("dün tanıştığım kadın"); English puts it after (the woman who I met yesterday).
introTr: Bir isim hakkında bilgi eklemek için kullanılır. Türkçede bu bilgi ismin önüne gelir ("dün tanıştığım kadın"), İngilizcede arkasına: the woman (who) I met yesterday.

examples: The man who lives next door is a pilot.
The book which I bought is great.
The film that we saw was long.

points.en: You can leave it out when it's the object

quiz.q: This is the phone ___ I want.
The people ___ live here are friendly.

title: Present simple
intro: Use the present simple for habits, routines and things that are always true. Add -s for he, she and it.
introTr: Alışkanlıklar, rutinler ve her zaman doğru olan şeyler için kullanılır. he/she/it ile fiile -s eklenir; Türkçe konuşanların en sık unuttuğu ek budur.

points.en: he / she / it + -s (-es after s, sh, ch, x, o)
points.tr: he/she/it + -s (s, sh, ch, x, o'dan sonra -es)
examples: He works. She watches. It goes.

points.en: Questions and negatives with do / does
examples: Does she live here? No, she doesn't.

points.en: Often with always, usually, often, sometimes, never

title: Present continuous
intro: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for actions happening now or around now, and for fixed future plans.
introTr: Şu anda ya da bu aralar olan şeyler ve kesinleşmiş gelecek planları için am/is/are + fiil-ing kullanılır. Türkçedeki -yor ekine benzer ama İngilizcede "know, like, want" gibi durum fiilleriyle kullanılmaz.

examples: She's living with her parents this year.

points.en: Not with state verbs: know, like, want, need, believe
examples: I know the answer. (not I'm knowing)

quiz.q: We ___ to Antalya next week. The tickets are booked.

title: Past simple
intro: Use the past simple for finished actions at a finished time. Regular verbs add -ed; many common verbs are irregular.
introTr: Bitmiş bir zamanda bitmiş eylemler için kullanılır. Düzenli fiillere -ed eklenir; en sık kullanılan fiillerin çoğu düzensizdir (go → went).

examples: go → went, see → saw, have → had, make → made, get → got, take → took
gitti, gördü, sahipti, yaptı, aldı, aldı

points.en: Questions and negatives: did + base verb
points.tr: Soru ve olumsuz: did + yalın fiil
examples: Did you see the match? I didn't see it.

points.en: Time words: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020

quiz.q: They ___ a new car two weeks ago.

title: Past continuous
intro: Use was/were + verb-ing for an action in progress at a moment in the past, often interrupted by a shorter action.
introTr: Geçmişte belli bir anda sürmekte olan eylem için was/were + fiil-ing kullanılır; çoğu zaman kısa bir eylem onu böler (-yordu).

points.en: In progress at a past time
examples: At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
I was walking home when it started to rain.

points.en: Two actions at the same time (while)
examples: While she was cooking, he was cleaning.
O yemek yaparken o da temizlik yapıyordu.

quiz.q: While I was sleeping, someone ___ my car.

title: Present perfect
intro: Use have/has + past participle for experiences, for past actions with a result now, and for situations that started in the past and continue.
introTr: Deneyimler, sonucu şimdi önemli olan geçmiş eylemler ve geçmişte başlayıp süren durumlar için have/has + üçüncü hâl kullanılır. Belirli bir geçmiş zamanla (yesterday, in 2020) kullanılmaz; bu Türkçe konuşanların en sık hatasıdır.

examples: Have you ever been to London?
I've lost my keys. (I can't find them now)

points.en: Started in the past and still true: for / since
examples: I've lived here for ten years.
I saw him yesterday. (not I've seen him yesterday)

title: Talking about the future
intro: English has no single future tense. Choose by meaning: will for decisions and predictions, going to for plans and evidence, present continuous for arrangements.
introTr: İngilizcede tek bir gelecek zaman yoktur. Anlama göre seçilir: anlık karar ve tahmin için will, plan ve kanıta dayalı tahmin için going to, ayarlanmış randevular için şimdiki zaman.

points.en: will: decisions now, promises, opinions about the future
examples: I think it will be hot tomorrow.

points.en: going to: plans and what you can see coming
points.tr: going to: planlar ve görünen gelecek
examples: Watch out! You're going to fall!

points.en: Present continuous: arrangements with a time
examples: I'm seeing the doctor at four.

quiz.q: "We have no milk." "OK, I ___ buy some."
Look at the sky. It ___ snow.

title: Comparatives and superlatives
intro: Short adjectives add -er / -est; long ones use more / most. Use than after a comparative and the before a superlative.
introTr: Kısa sıfatlara -er/-est eklenir, uzun sıfatlarda more/most kullanılır. Karşılaştırmadan sonra than, en üstünlükten önce the gelir.

examples: It's the tallest building in the city.
This book is more interesting than that one.

points.en: Irregular: good → better → best, bad → worse → worst, far → further
examples: Her English is better than mine.
He's as tall as his father.

quiz.q: This is the ___ expensive hotel in town.

title: Countable and uncountable nouns
intro: Countable nouns have a plural (one book, two books). Uncountable nouns don't (water, money, advice) and take a singular verb.
introTr: Sayılabilen isimlerin çoğulu vardır (book → books). Sayılamayanların yoktur (water, money, advice) ve tekil fiil alır. Türkçede sayılabilen bazı kelimeler İngilizcede sayılamaz: information, advice, news, furniture.

points.en: Counting them: a piece of, a glass of, a bottle of
points.tr: Sayarken: a piece of, a glass of

points.en: Some words are uncountable in English but not in Turkish
points.tr: Türkçede sayılabilen ama İngilizcede sayılamayan kelimeler
examples: information, advice, news, furniture, luggage, homework, research
bilgi, tavsiye, haber, mobilya, bagaj, ödev, araştırma

quiz.q: There ___ a lot of traffic today.

title: -ing or to + verb?
intro: After some verbs the next verb takes -ing, after others to + verb. There is no rule you can see; learn them in pairs.
introTr: Bazı fiillerden sonra gelen fiil -ing, bazılarından sonra to + fiil alır. Kural yoktur; çift olarak öğrenmek en iyisidir.

points.en: + -ing: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, suggest, can't stand
+ to: want, need, decide, hope, plan, learn, promise, would like
Both, same meaning: like, love, start, begin
points.tr: İkisi de, aynı anlam: like, love, start

title: If: first and second conditional
intro: First conditional: real, possible future (if + present, will). Second conditional: imagined or unlikely (if + past, would).
introTr: Birinci koşul: gerçek, olası gelecek (if + geniş zaman, will). İkinci koşul: hayalî ya da düşük ihtimalli durum (if + geçmiş zaman, would). If'li kısımda will kullanılmaz.

examples: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
If I had more money, I would buy a house.
Daha çok param olsa ev alırdım.
If I were you, I'd take the job.
Senin yerinde olsam işi kabul ederdim.
If you call me, I'll come. (not If you will call)

quiz.q: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
If she studies, she ___ the exam.
If I were you, I ___ see a doctor.

title: The passive
intro: Use be + past participle when the action matters more than who does it. Add by + person only if it's useful.
introTr: Eylemi yapan değil eylemin kendisi önemliyse be + üçüncü hâl kullanılır. Yapanı söylemek gerekirse by eklenir. Türkçedeki -ıl/-ın ekine benzer.

examples: English is spoken all over the world.
This book was written by Orhan Pamuk.
Bu kitap Orhan Pamuk tarafından yazıldı.

points.en: With modals: can be, must be, will be

title: Question words and word order
intro: Put the question word first, then the auxiliary (do, is, can…), then the subject, then the main verb.
introTr: Soru kelimesi başa gelir, ardından yardımcı fiil (do, is, can…), sonra özne, sonra ana fiil. Türkçede soru eki sonda olduğu için sıralama ters gelir.

points.tr: Soru kelimesi + yardımcı fiil + özne + fiil

points.en: who, what, where, when, why, how, which, whose
points.tr: kim, ne, nerede, ne zaman, neden, nasıl, hangi, kimin

examples: How old are you? How much is it? How often do you swim?
Kaç yaşındasın? Ne kadar? Ne sıklıkla yüzersin?
Who called you? (not Who did call you)
